title: cubacle run options
description: How much to compute. Run options never change the pattern. The command line options are short (--limit, --count); the JSON keys are the long names.

stateLimit.description: Print at most this many states (--limit). Default 20.

sampleSeed.description: Seed of the draw for sampleSize (--seed).

maxStates.description: Hard cap on the enumeration (--max-states). Default 50000000.

maxDepth.description: Depth limit of the move search; only with solve (--max-depth).
